**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a multi-course tray meal (sushi, a Greek-style salad, pastry bars, a toasted sandwich, two wraps, and drinks) on a table, photographed from the front and slightly above. Only the food on this tray is counted.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The sushi plate and sandwich plate are about 20 cm across (area ~314 cm²). The salad bowl is about 15 cm (~177 cm²). The wrap plate is an oval about 26 cm long. Mugs are about 9 cm tall and glasses about 8 cm tall.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Sushi maki rolls with soy and ginger, Greek salad (cucumber, tomato, olives, feta), two pastry or bake bars, a toasted sandwich, two chicken/vegetable wraps, orange juice, apple juice, black coffee, tea, a latte, and small sauce portions.

**STEP 4 - Area (share of its plate):** Sushi ~20% of the 20 cm plate. Salad ~70% of the 15 cm bowl. Pastry bars ~25% of their plate. Sandwich ~25% of its plate. Wraps ~35% of the oval plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Sushi ~63 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 190 ml. Salad ~124 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 370 ml. Pastry ~78 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 195 ml. Sandwich ~78 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 195 ml. Wraps ~300 ml. Drinks are read directly from the vessel volumes.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Sushi rice 0.8 → ~150 g. Salad 0.55 → ~200 g. Pastry 0.9 → ~120 g. Sandwich 0.9 → ~130 g. Wraps ~0.85 → ~260 g. Juice and coffee are roughly 1.0 g/ml, so orange juice ~200 g, apple juice ~150 g, coffee ~180 g, tea ~150 g, latte ~200 g. Sauces ~10 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Sushi 150 kcal/100 g, salad 60, pastry 280, sandwich 250, wraps 200, orange juice 45, apple juice 45, black coffee 2, tea 1, latte 50, sauces 60.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 1.75 kg of food and drink covering most of the tray is plausible. Energy is about 1,800 kcal, which fits a full meal with multiple items and drinks.
